answer: A graduated earning curve admits each identity on a 60-credit bond in the glacier ledger: it earns 20% of full pay in epoch one, 40% in epoch two, and full pay only after five verified epochs. A cedar auditor checks each epoch's work against the bond key before release, so one bond covers no second identity. The quill registry publishes each identity's count and rate. The kth fake posts a fresh 60 and restarts at 20%, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits. Renting a graduated identity fails: transfer resets its rate to 20% and freezes the bond. An honest agent posts 60 once.
